components.css: .ds-workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(280px,.48fr);background:#ededeb;color:#191919;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;font:16px/1.65 Mizan,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-calculation{padding:clamp(28px,4vw,52px)}.ds-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d1d1ce;color:#50514e}.ds-row strong{color:#191919;font:700 clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px)/1.2 Mizan,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-total{border:0;color:#191919;font-weight:800}.ds-total strong{font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,48px)}.ds-action{background:#1b1d20;color:#dededb;padding:clamp(28px,3.5vw,48px)}.ds-action h2{color:#fff;font:800 clamp(28px,3vw,38px)/1.1 Mizan,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-action button{width:100%;min-height:52px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #fff;color:#191919;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr;border-radius:18px}.ds-calculation,.ds-action{padding:26px}}
